title: 菊花賞の後に・喝采！三冠祭り

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: They're coming into the final turn! Just listen to the crowd roar!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (I can hear them… I hear them loud and clear! They want this race to ramp up even more!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (I get it now. Races are just like festivals! And if that's the case…)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (I'll have to take the lead and be the Umamusume setting the tempo for everyone! This is my festival! All right…)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll become the Triple Crown champion! Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yeaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, check out Kitasan Black! She was a complete no-name when she first started out, but look at her now.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That running of hers always pulls at the heartstrings! And now, she's even gotten the Triple Crown! She's the real deal…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not even her idol, Tokai Teio, managed to get the Triple Crown. Her spirited performance seems to have convinced even the most stubborn of fans to notice her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Nature! Thank you so much!
choice_data_list: Congrats on winning the Triple Crown, Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I couldn't have done it without the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So, what did you think? Were you able to run in a way that didn't give people the chance to notice that the star of the race was missing?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um, well… I'm not sure what people noticed or thought, but…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I was able to run it the way I wanted to! It felt like I was throwing my very own festival today! A Kitasan festival!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: A Kitasan festival!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Then I suppose it would be a "Nice Nature festival" in my case…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, no, no. I don't think I can do that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I take back what I said. Kitasan really is a star racer after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Her ability to recover after a setback is far too incredible. Goodness, there's no way I can compare to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature shrugs helplessly, but her smile doesn't fade a bit.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Kita. I watched your race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Teio!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio comes by to give her well wishes too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! It's hard to believe I've made it so far!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That first time I saw you run inspired me more than you'll ever know.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So much has happened along the way, but you were always there for me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. Congratulations, Kita. I'm as happy for you as if I had won myself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …At least, I was going to say that until I saw the race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I've always considered you my cute little mentee, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But things are different now. You did what I couldn't, and you've carved your name into the history books.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You'll forever be known as a Triple Crown champion now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: T-Teio… It was just luck that I got to run in all the Triple Crown races, though.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: If that hadn't happened, there's no doubt you would've been able to do the same!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Luck had nothing to do with it. Your toughness is what got you through the fall gauntlet of races I couldn't.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's your strength and the strength of everyone behind you who brought you through this, so be proud of your accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Teio…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Your eyes haven't changed a bit since you were a kid. You're always looking straight at what you want.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I think I might've been hoping for this day to come ever since I first met your gaze…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The day you'd be at my level, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio's childish and carefree air is nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now, her expression clearly resembles that of a champion, brimming with frustration and fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'd better get going, Kita. Thanks for letting me say things as they stand.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I just couldn't help myself after seeing your run. You did really great out there. Later, then.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black bows at Tokai Teio until she's completely out of sight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Another major event takes place later that day too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You are now a Triple Crown champion, young Bakushin grasshopper. I have nothing left to teach you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This class rep here has crossed paths with you indeed, but now she must be off. Other poor souls need a helping hand.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You're going already, Bakushin O?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I am. You are not the only one driven to help others.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O… You've taught me something of the utmost importance!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: To Bakushin is to do! No matter what and no matter when, you must keep going!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It may seem simple, but never giving up and forever moving onward is critical beyond words!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll never forget that, ever.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Good! Keep moving forward! In the Victory Club I was taught at, I wrote that the kanji for "progress" should be read as "Bakushin"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My teacher docked off points when I did that on my spelling test, but hey! Anyways, see ya! Bakushin to your own tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then, Sakura Bakushin O disappears the same way she arrived—with a sonic boom.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Our own tomorrow… She's right. Tomorrow doesn't come just for me. Next is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black has won the Triple Crown, but there is another brand-new story that's getting underway in the pouring rain.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: GOOOOO! DIAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond has come first in her debut race! That's right, this 500 million carat racer has seized victory! She's a real diamond in the rough!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia… Way to go! You've got to keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I bet you'll manage to win a G1 race no problem if you do, which means you'll be able to make your wish come true, and then… and then!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm sure too, Kita. I may have started later than you, but I will catch up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So go on ahead and watch me carefully! Next year, once the Classic Triple Crown is over…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's race together on the stage where the best of the classic and senior athletes gather, the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen! What do you think, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is officially our goal. We'll have one year to prepare for the dream ahead of us.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll hit the ground running! The Kikuka Sho was my little Kitasan festival, but the Arima is a bona fide year-end festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I bet Dad's gonna love it! I've gotta make sure to ramp it up to twenty!
